whatItDoes: Allow the district to borrow $1.8 million from a state authority for capital improvements needed to keep its wastewater system operating. Total repayment would be capped at $4.14 million, and the maximum net effective interest rate would be 6.5% a year. The district board would set the loan’s terms within these limits. The question also authorizes additional taxes if needed for repayment, as described below. It gives no loan duration.
yesMeans: Approve this state-agency loan for the wastewater system, the stated repayment and interest limits, and its conditional property-tax backing and investment-earnings provision.
noMeans: Do not authorize this loan or its associated taxes and investment-earnings provision through this measure.

parts.label: Property-tax backing
parts.what: The opening clause authorizes a tax increase of up to $20,000 annually if necessary. The repayment clause also authorizes property taxes in any year, without a stated tax-rate ceiling and in an amount sufficient to pay principal and interest, when other legally available district revenues are insufficient. Both clauses are part of the question.

parts.label: Investment earnings
parts.what: Investment earnings on revenues and taxes available to repay this debt would be treated as a voter-approved revenue change. This provision concerns those earnings.
